environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on EC2 (m5.xlarge) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4) in us-east-1. The service runs in a private subnet with direct NLB passthrough (no TLS termination at LB). IAM role attached to EC2 has SecretsManager read access. No request throttling at infrastructure level. NLB preserves client connections with TCP keepalive enabled, providing stable low-jitter network path ideal for timing measurements. JVM runs with -XX:-TieredCompilation to ensure consistent execution timing.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 m5.xlarge behind NLB (TCP passthrough)
config.network: NLB Layer4, no WAF, TCP keepalive, same-AZ client access permitted
config.tls: terminated at application level (Spring Boot embedded Tomcat)
